notes: Identified as console/parking-brake console mount U-nut (Dr. Rebuild repro set, black plated; Chevy II/Nova AIM 'console to front bracket'), but no thread size found. Dr. Rebuild page: expired certificate; eBay kit 403. Round 4: also used as lower dash pad clip (CorvetteParts.com 400979 set, GM 9422242 & 3909593) and Nova console 'U' nut (console to front bracket); no thread size. Searches: '9422242 U nut', '9422242 camaros'.
